summary: Chesapeake Utilities Corp and its subsidiary Peninsula Pipeline Company filed an 8-K announcing the Florida Energy Pathway, a ~$1.2B intrastate natural gas pipeline project from Palm Beach to Miami-Dade County. The project has firm commitments for ~250,000 dekatherms/day from investment-grade shippers and upstream capacity from Florida Gas Transmission's Phase IX expansion. In-service is targeted for 2030, pending design finalization. Chesapeake plans to partner with third parties to invest up to 49% of the project. This is a routine capital investment announcement, not a special situation event.
